purpose: E06-S04: every long flag of the four commands the Python CLI and the Rust engine share, and what `cancellai` 2.0.0 does with it. tests/test_cli_inventory.py checks this against the Python parser, the Rust help goldens and the Unreleased release notes.

status.--json: changed: prints the JSON_CONTRACTS inventory document, not the Python summary
status.--allow-running: added: proceed although a provider process appears to be running, as clean already could

clean.--json: changed: prints the JSON_CONTRACTS plan or result document

configure.--claude-retention: changed: refused on Windows (no verified handle-bound settings write there yet); macOS and Linux as before

version.--source: added: also print the detected installation source (E17-S04)

presentation.version: changed: `cancellai version` prints `cancellai-cli <version>`, naming the engine; `cancellai-legacy --version` prints the Python reference's
presentation.help: changed: help text names the program `cancellai-cli`, the engine's own name
